snippet.title: Steadfast - May Update Trailer
snippet.description:
All New Demo Coming to itch.io and Game Jolt!

The First Demo Now Available on itch.io and Game Jolt!

Get it on itch.io: https://riverofchaos.itch.io/steadfast

Get it on Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/steadfast/1041066

Support it on Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/jordanduncan

Behold! I will be releasing a new demo soon! It will include everything I've been working on including:

    • A slightly improved look
    • Two brand new levels
    • With two brand new tracks
    • Some new moves
    • A new enemy
    • Victory animations
    • A revamped UI
    • And even a sound test

By the way, I also have a Ko-fi. If you feel I'm onto something, you can support me there as well if you like. Thank you for your curiosity!

About Steadfast:

Steadfast is a brand new momentum based 3D platformer that is now in development, with a playable demo now available on itch.io and Game Jolt! With fluent, yet fast paced movement and a unique cel-shaded, fifth gen inspired art style, Steadfast aims to be a game that gets your adrenaline pumping and your feet rolling!

With four characters to choose from, up to four friends can rush through Capital Island, as they journey on a quest to take down the oppressive Kaizo Empire!

This game is in early development. As such, all of the gameplay featured in this upcoming demo is subject to change. In fact, the gameplay featured in this trailer isn't final. Although I would appreciate your support, both demos will be supplied completely free of charge.
